visualCharacteristics.purpose: Placeholder for the live product listing of a store category
visualCharacteristics.description: Until it is connected to the store search system, renders a single centered call-to-action link "Shop all <last category level>" to the live listing on shopmyexchange.com. No product data.

contentPattern.description: Store category path with levels separated by " > " (e.g. Electronics > Computers). The path alone in one cell is also accepted; empty rows are ignored. The parsed path is exposed on the block as data-category.

usage: Placeholder for a category's product listing (item count, sort, product grid, paging) on category pages.
reuseGuidance: Use once per category page where the source shows the store's product grid. Author only the category path; the block links to the live listing until the search integration is built.
